Henderson orders ship from the USA and Canada under the shipping policy that governs every order across the United States. Keeping peptides cool in Henderson

The official climate station for the Las Vegas Valley is at Harry Reid International Airport.4 Its 1991 to 2020 normals give January a high of 58.5 °F and a low of 40.5 °F, and July a high of 104.5 °F with nights that average 82.0 °F.2 The station averages 137.1 days a year at or above 90 °F and 4.18 inches of precipitation a year.9

After heat, moisture is the other thing peptide makers warn about. Bachem, a peptide manufacturer, says peptides tend to be hygroscopic, meaning they pull water from the air, and that absorbed moisture lowers the powder's peptide content and may also lower its stability.56 GenScript, another maker, names sequences containing Asp, Glu, Lys, Arg or His as prone to absorbing moisture and says they belong in a desiccator, in a tightly capped vial.7

In practice, that means two habits. Bring a delivered parcel indoors and into cold storage promptly, and when a vial later comes out of the refrigerator or freezer, let it reach room temperature, ideally in a desiccator, before the cap comes off.5 The storage guide and the reconstitution guide cover the rest.

About Henderson

The Census Bureau estimated 353,289 Henderson residents on July 1, 2025,10 and the city's own fact sheet gives 369,167 for January 2025.11 The city covers 121.12 square miles of land.12 It occupies the southern rim of the Las Vegas Valley, from east of Boulder Highway to just east of Interstate 15, at an elevation the city gives as 1,940 feet, and it lists access to the Colorado River, Lake Mead and Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area, along with Black Mountain and the River and McCullough Mountains, among its features.11

Henderson grew out of World War II. The BMI (Basic Magnesium) plant became the world's largest magnesium plant and drew almost 15,000 workers from across the country. A post office opened in 1944, named for former U.S. Senator Charles B. Henderson, and the city incorporated on April 16, 1953.3 It now counts 25 master-planned communities, among them Anthem, Cadence, Inspirada, Lake Las Vegas, MacDonald Ranch Highlands and Southfork.1314 Annual events and local parades are still held in the Water Street District, which the city calls its original main street.1

Higher education in Henderson includes the College of Southern Nevada, Nevada State University, Touro University Nevada and a Roseman University campus.14 CMS lists four acute care hospitals with Henderson addresses: the St. Rose Dominican Rose de Lima and Siena campuses, Henderson Hospital and West Henderson Hospital, which the city describes as newly opened.1514 The Siena campus is one of Southern Nevada's four designated trauma centers, at Level III.16 A ClinicalTrials.gov search on October 25, 2026 returned 65 recruiting studies with a site matching "Henderson, Nevada", a rough gauge because it matches addresses by name.17

Henderson skews older than the county: its median age is 42.8 years against 38.5 county-wide, and 20.8 percent of residents are 65 or older, the same share as those under 18 (ACS 2020 to 2024).1819 Two in three occupied homes (66.1 percent) are owner-occupied, and 37.4 percent of adults 25 and older hold a bachelor's degree or higher.2021

Frequently asked questions

Can semaglutide or tirzepatide research vials be shipped to Henderson?

Yes. Both ship to Henderson addresses from the USA and Canada, under the same policy that covers orders across the United States. Semaglutide and tirzepatide, sold under the store name TRZ GLP2, each have a product page showing the strengths offered and current stock. Both are sold for laboratory research under the research use policy, and the shipping page explains how orders travel.

Is Henderson part of Las Vegas?

No. Henderson is its own city, incorporated on April 16, 1953, and it calls itself Nevada's second largest city.31 It sits on the southern rim of the Las Vegas Valley,11 which it shares with the City of Las Vegas, North Las Vegas and several unincorporated towns, so this page links up to the Las Vegas hub. For an order, the difference does not matter: a Henderson address is handled like any other.

Does the desert's dry air protect peptide powder from moisture?

Not by itself. The National Weather Service calls Las Vegas the driest major metropolitan area in the continental United States,4 but peptide makers give their moisture advice in general terms, not for dry climates only. Peptides tend to absorb water from the air, so Bachem advises letting a cold container reach room temperature in a desiccator before opening it, and GenScript advises weighing out what is needed quickly and resealing the vial tightly.567
